about_the_game:
One Map is a revolutionary online multiplayer third-person shooter game where the entire world joins a single, never-ending battle royale. With no match-making wait times, you instantly dive into continuous PVP action, surrounded by players from across the globe. Gamers are tired of complicated menus and long waits — in One Map, the focus is on what matters most: the action. The map dynamically adjusts its size based on how many players are online, so it's never too big to feel empty or too small to feel crowded, ensuring the perfect balance for engaging gameplay and strategy. When you die, jump straight back into the death match and keep trying to survive longer than before.

The goal is simple: survival. Play solo and rely on your own skills, or team up with friends to get an edge in this intense third person shooter. Every second counts, and the clock is always ticking. It’s simple to play but hard to master—perfect for those looking for a real shooter challenge.

One Map’s goal is to break the world record for the most players online in a single game. With its continuous game design, One Map brings players together in one massive, real-time battle royale. The current record is 8,825 players, and we need your help to beat it. Join the fight, stay alive, and make gaming history in this ultimate survival showdown.

Features:

One Global Game: No more waiting for match-making! Everyone around the world is playing the same game, so there's always a strategy-packed match to join in this intense PVP arena.

Dynamic Map Size: The map expands or contracts based on the number of players online, ensuring it's never too big or too small, creating the perfect environment for intense action and strategic play.

Survive Together or Alone: Play solo to test your skills, or team up with friends to gain an advantage in this intense third person shooter.

Real-Time Leaderboards: Track your progress with in-game leaderboards that rank every current player based on survival time. The player who has survived the longest will be ranked first, followed by the rest. Additionally, view daily, weekly, and all-time leaderboards that highlight the top players in this thrilling battle royale experience.

Combat Variety: Take down opponents your way—shoot them in PVP combat, sneak up for an assassination, or celebrate a win with dance moves.

Choose Your Character: Pick from a variety of characters with unique appearances. They all perform the same but let you customize your look on the battlefield.

How long can you survive? The longer you stay in the game, the greater the battle royale challenge. Dive into One Map - Never Ending Battle now, and see how long you can last in this intense multiplayer action and strategy game!

content_descriptors.notes: One Map is a third person shooter featuring online multiplayer battles. Players engage in PVP combat using firearms to kill each other in order to stay alive longer, but the game does not include blood, gore, or dismemberment. There are no depictions of sexual content, drug use, or self-harm.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04+, SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870 / Intel Iris Plus Graphics
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any

mac_requirements.minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2015 or newer) or Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 6000 or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any

The dynamic map adjusts to the player count, ensuring non-stop combat. Survive, compete, and help break the world record for the most players online in a game.
